method: Same player/game, >=3 exact 96x96 grayscale image hashes or >=80% shared source interval. Not a perceptual biomechanics classifier.
unresolvedClipUnitPolicy: Unlinked clips remain clip observations and never inflate unique-pitch aggregates.
limitations: Recompressed, recropped, mirrored or speed-edited replays can evade exact hashes; zero matches does not establish physical uniqueness.
